paragraphs.text: 5ColorControl (commonly called 5 Color Control or Five Color Control ) is a Magic: The Gathering webcomic.
5ColorControl was started in February 2009. The writer at the time was Taylor Connor, and the artist was Alex Evangelou. In May 2009, Alex quit as artist, and Steve Zaffke replaced him.
It looks like they have stopped making them since there hasn't been a new comic in over a year.
